# goslop text fixture — expected-exception async test: single await + specific
# catch + pass (niquests wasi_guest edge_cases FP)
lang: python
file: tests/wasi_guest/async/edge_cases.py
---
async def low_level_cases():
    failed = LowLevelResponse(Reader([Err(Failed())]))
    try:
        await failed.read(1)
    except ReadTimeout:
        pass

    other = LowLevelResponse(Reader([ValueError("bad")]))
    try:
        await other.read(1)
    except ValueError:
        pass
